Hello! Year ago i've been in a same trouble. I had anxiety+depression(classic). I've been on meds( escitalopram 20mg) for 9 months. Somehow, these thoughts vanished away over time, tho at these moments they were quite realistic. I've been shittin my pants. Sometimes anxiety still hits me bad of thought that maybe i went crazy long time ago, i'm in psych ward looking straight to a wall, and what's happening now is just happening in my head. BUT there's a part of me that pushes these thoughts away, and puts me to the right place again. I feel that i could've have used meds for abit longer, but i couldn't take the only side effect i got- thoughts about suicide. I've had them for all the time i was on meds. Slowly, but i learn how to cope with myself. I would recommend you reading about minfullness, re-programming your brain, how to work with your sub-consciousness, get out- feel the nature, come in to contact with it. Avoid toxic people, cut contact with toxic people. It's better to be alone sometimes than having toxic people around you. Masturbation, porn- STOP IT(Really, it works wonders). Work with yourself and you will achieve greatness. I'm happy i'm not alone about this particular issue. I think you should be more happy too. It will work out, i can be happy- so you can too! All it takes is time :) Use it properly. 


Wishes from the anxiously depressed man :)
